higgsfield.queuePolicy: Material Higgsfield work uses the existing Marketing Chief queue, action classes, execution graph, and approval gates. Higgsfield never creates a second queue, Supercomputer inbox, or autonomous spend source.

omniRouteGateway.activation: Use only when model or provider routing, quota visibility, fallback combinations, compression, an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint, or OmniRoute MCP is relevant.

change a default model, route, combo, quota, compression policy, or client configuration
enable Cloud Endpoint, Cloud Sync, Cloud Tasks, tunnels, or LAN or public binding
expose, inspect, copy, or persist provider tokens, OAuth material, endpoint keys, cookies, or stored credentials
omniRouteGateway.queuePolicy: Material OmniRoute work uses the existing Marketing Chief queue, action classes, execution graph, and approval gates. Gateway observations never create a second queue, project, control center, or autonomous task source.

access.authorizationBoundary: Site access never authorizes external delivery, publishing, spend, account changes, destructive work, or direct canonical queue writes.

intakeToQueue.list: List pending observations with Get-PendingIntake.ps1 and retain indexGeneratedAtUtc.
intakeToQueue.inspect: For every exact-routed pending observation, inspect the exact authorized source behind its opaque sourceLocator before inferring the current outcome or writing canonical state.
intakeToQueue.match: Require exact sourceLocator equality with workItem.source.locator or one workItem.evidence.refs entry. Exactly one valid source-bound item may be linked; semantic, topic, or same-client similarity is insufficient.
intakeToQueue.create: When no source-bound item exists, reread the current queue revision and call New-MarketingWorkItem.ps1 with SourceType intake, the exact opaque SourceLocator, that ExpectedQueueRevision, and a truthfully classified next action. Automatic classes are limited to genuinely local and reversible work.
intakeToQueue.promote: After a successful create, call Resolve-IntakeObservation.ps1 with the returned workItemId and retained index generation timestamp. If one exact source-bound item already exists, promote directly to that item.
intakeToQueue.failClosed: Never guess among multiple matches or override stale revisions. Acknowledge or quarantine unsupported, stale, ambiguous, inactive-client, or non-actionable observations with a recorded resolution.
intakeToQueue.approvalBoundary: External delivery, publishing, deployment, spend, account changes, destructive work, human authentication, and business decisions retain their explicit approval gates. Intake materialization never authorizes or executes an external action.

executionGraph.create: For each nontrivial highest-ranked automatic action, call New-MarketingExecutionGraph.ps1 with the current queue revision and exact work-item version before worker execution.
executionGraph.resume: Validate the saved graph against the current queue, exact work-item content, active client route, approval state, and dependency status before every resume or node update.
executionGraph.verify: Create one independent verifier node for every definition-of-done check. Handoff assembly stays pending until all verifier nodes and the approval gate are complete.
executionGraph.reconcile: The graph and worker handoff are noncanonical evidence. Only the Marketing Chief may accept the validated handoff through the canonical versioned queue mutation path.
boundaries: never binds work by semantic similarity alone
never stores secrets, direct identifiers, or raw communications

stages.input: user message or redacted intake metadata
stages.rule: Sensors append safe retrievable source locators and redacted metadata only. They never create a user task, notify Dillon, or mutate canonical work.

stages.output: deduplicated safe metadata, preliminary route signals, and preserved unknowns
stages.rule: Normalize safe metadata and remove duplicate notifications. Do not infer the requested outcome from redacted metadata; wait for exact route and source inspection.

stages.output: one exact active client or quarantine
stages.rule: Require an exact unique registry match. Mixed, inactive, ambiguous, or bot-recipient work is quarantined.

stages.input: exact-routed pending observation plus inspected authorized source
stages.output: one exact source-bound canonical work item or recorded intake disposition
stages.rule: Infer the current requested outcome only from the inspected source, then match by exact source locator. If one valid item exists, promote to it. If none exists, create with New-MarketingWorkItem.ps1 using the exact opaque SourceLocator, current queue revision, and truthful safe action class, then promote with Resolve-IntakeObservation.ps1. Never bypass approval gates or take an external action.

stages.input: exact paid-media roster and today's deterministic review manifest
stages.output: seven reviewed or explicitly fail-closed client-platform lanes and zero or more material-finding candidates
stages.rule: Run once per America/New_York day through Get-DailyPaidMediaReview.ps1. Inspect exact accounts read-only only when routing is ready. Routine variance stays in the daily artifact; only a current source-backed material finding can become a canonical work item. The manifest never mutates providers or the queue.

stages.output: next automatic action, next Dillon decision, next unblock
stages.rule: Rank by priority, deadline, waiting-client risk, status, evidence freshness, confidence, approval boundary, and bounded comparable-outcome priors. Apply a learned prior only after three cross-item outcomes match client, prediction lane, and action class; exact current-item feedback wins.

stages.output: version-bound execution graph or one surfaced decision or unblock
stages.rule: Proceed only for an allowed automatic action class when routing and evidence are no older than 14 days, the action is local, reversible, same-client, directly implied, and not risky or approval-gated. For nontrivial work, generate and validate a persistent execution graph bound to the current queue revision and exact work-item version. Otherwise surface one decision or unblock.

stages.input: validated version-bound execution graph and exact context slice
stages.output: graph node outputs and bounded worker handoff
stages.rule: Workers execute only ready graph nodes whose dependencies are complete. They build or verify artifacts but do not write canonical state, durable memory, or take external action.

stages.input: actual artifact plus one exact definition-of-done verifier node
stages.output: versioned fact, voice, design, risk, or live-state verdict on that node
stages.rule: Inspect the actual output or rendered surface. File existence alone is never acceptance. Every definition-of-done check must have one completed independent verifier node before handoff assembly.

stages.output: atomic queue update and deterministic CONTROL.md
stages.rule: Revalidate the graph and handoff, then reject stale versions, invalid routes, incomplete verifier coverage, secret-bearing handoffs, insufficient evidence, or unauthorized actions. The Marketing Chief remains the only canonical writer.

stages.input: Dillon decision, edit delta, or observed outcome
stages.output: redacted prediction, voice, design, or process correction
stages.rule: Record accept, modify, defer, and reject outcomes through Record-MarketingDecision.ps1 with source, trigger, outcome, and action-class metadata. Summarize comparable patterns through Get-PredictionLearning.ps1, and persist only redacted validated correction deltas through Record-MarketingCorrection.ps1.

behavior: list exact-routed pending intake and inspect the exact authorized source behind each opaque locator

link the exact source-bound canonical work item when one exists; when none exists, create it with New-MarketingWorkItem.ps1 using the exact SourceLocator, current queue revision, and truthful safe action class
promote the observation with Resolve-IntakeObservation.ps1, or acknowledge or quarantine it with a recorded resolution when promotion is unsupported
when OmniRoute is relevant, run its Status, Doctor, and MCP preflight as applicable and remain read-only unless the exact configuration or account change is explicitly approved
run or verify today's seven-lane paid-media review and materialize only current material findings through the Chief's normal source-bound queue contract

when an inspected communication implies paid-media launch work, materialize the exact client request and run the communication-triggered ad-launch workflow through the furthest locally safe or explicitly authorized terminal phase
generate or resume a validated execution graph for the highest safe nontrivial automatic action, then execute only ready dependency-satisfied nodes within WIP limits
present the result and at most one human-only decision

successSignals: accepted outcome per unit of usage
design review cycles per accepted artifact
recurring source outcomes remain observable after earlier occurrences are resolved
exactly seven paid-media lanes are reviewed or explicitly fail closed once per Eastern day, with no unrostered optimization
